description: WORKED EXAMPLE (not shipped): the exact JSON to add sertraline as a 15th supported drug. Copy the ingredient into data/drug_catalog.json `ingredients`, the drug into `drugs`, bump `catalog_version`, add a change_log entry, then run `npm run config:test`. Identifiers verified on RxNav 2026-11-12 (RxNorm 02-Nov-2026): IN 36437 'sertraline', PIN 155137 'sertraline hydrochloride'. Adding this requires no change to the state machine, the recall engine or any screen. Test: tests/integration/config_extensibility.test.ts.
